texts: A top-down editorial view of a real snack package lying on white paper, centered and opened vertically down the middle with intact folds and crinkled material visible on both sides. From the opening, a vibrant miniature landscape erupts, rendered entirely in expressive colored pencil and crayon strokes with visible paper grain, granular texture, and uneven hand-painted color blocks. The scene depicts Qingdao's iconic landmarks and coastal features, including the small train and red-tiled roofs, constructed from these sketchy, artistic lines rather than smooth 3D models. The real packaging material's glossy reflections contrast sharply with the matte, hand-drawn interior world. A short title 'Qingdao' appears in the upper margin of the paper, separate from the packaging print. No fake English text, random letters, or brand logos are present on the package.

An open pop-up book viewed from a slightly angled three-quarter perspective, where intricate paper cutouts and folded layers rise from the spine to form a miniature stage of Qingdao. The scene features the city's distinctive architecture and street life crafted from textured paper, with visible cut edges, overlapping layers, and bent pathways. The color palette is soft and neutral, dominated by sage green, warm blush pink, and paper tones, with subtle accent colors reflecting the theme. The lighting is gentle and diffuse, highlighting the tactile nature of the paper craft. The composition is a complete, readable tableau with shallow depth of field, focusing on the structural elegance of the paper folds without using real glass or photographic elements.

A warm beige scroll unrolling in the foreground, with the rolled edge visible on the left, supporting a raised miniature landscape made of felt and fiber. The scene depicts Qingdao's main landmarks and soft, rounded fiber trees and terrain, all crafted with a handmade, tactile quality. Viewed from a low, slanted macro angle, the foreground scroll edge and mid-ground structures are sharp, while the background softens. Warm natural light illuminates the woolen textures and soft topography. The composition is a single, self-contained micro-landscape on the scroll, featuring the city's architecture as felt blocks, distinct from a nine-grid collage or digital interface.

A clear, brand-less glass essence bottle, fully visible from cap to base, containing a luxurious miniature theater inside. The transparent liquid forms a reflective pool at the bottom, supporting a delicate stage with an arched colonnade rising behind it. Inside, a miniature conductor and musicians in Qingdao-themed attire are clearly visible, performing with instruments on a velvet-seated stage adorned with rose-like plants. The lighting is soft and side-lit, casting a champagne gold and blush rose hue, with tiny droplets cascading from the rim. The focus is sharp on the intricate interior narrative, ensuring the figures and stage are the core of the scene, distinct from a simple drift bottle or empty container.

An open, worn vintage matchbox resting on a dark wooden table, with the outer sleeve and inner tray clearly visible. Rising from the inner tray is a miniature world of Qingdao, featuring scaled-down streets, trees, and landmarks that fit entirely within the box's boundaries. The scene is lit by the warm, cinematic glow of a single burning matchstick lying nearby among scattered matches. The macro, slanted angle captures the realistic model textures, thin mist, and depth of field. The box shows signs of age with scratches and travel marks. The miniature structures, including bridges and buildings, are fully supported by the box's interior base, with no elements extending beyond the box walls onto the table.

A complete, collectible textile miniature model of Qingdao, viewed from a slanted medium shot that captures the entire outline, including the fabric edges at the bottom, the entrance, and the tops of the main landmarks. The scene is constructed entirely from knitted yarn, felt, embroidery, and plush materials, showing clear fiber details, stitch lines, and soft, rounded volumes. The architecture resembles layered fabric pieces rather than plastic models. The color palette uses warm neutrals with local accent colors, illuminated by soft natural light and shadows against a simple, soft-colored background. Tiny hand-knitted dolls depict characters engaged in local activities, distinct from realistic human photos, creating a cozy, tactile world of yarn and wool.
